# Iso editor golden inputs

Integration contract 1.1 keeps fixture JSON schemas and PNG bytes unchanged. Verified preview, staged publication, revision acknowledgement and draft picking are service APIs; they add no persisted fields. The valid test-crate source identity remains `88d16cbb12cbb96f98521eba4389d19d66789cca5395002227cb9d0dd91b1034`. Real-service acceptance uses these same inputs; see [integration QA](../../../docs/iso-editor-integration.md).

`cases.json` is the case index. Paths are relative to this folder. All inputs are synthetic. Local .gitattributes pins JSON to LF and PNGs to binary so the byte-based content-hash golden is stable after Windows checkout. These are source acceptance fixtures for the implementation lanes, not evidence that the stub editor works.

For `kind:layout`, load the embedded iso pack merged with an empty user catalog (including the objects lane's virtual `iso/computer` adapter), then parse the complete JSON using the new Core loader/aggregate validator. A valid file must produce no Error. An invalid file must include every `expectedRules` ID as an Error; additional independent Errors are allowed. Core owns layout files and enables the related skeletons. L019 graph/corrupted-part checks use constructed pack doubles rather than inventing layout part overrides.

For `kind:object`, call importer Validate on the local `.iso.json` alongside its PNG. The valid crate has one independently authored rotation, a 64×80 source cell, anchor (32,48), 1×1 blocking footprint, height16 and a physical contact check. Import must preserve PNG bytes exactly and match `expectedContentHash` from the index using spec §7.3; cycling R fails C003. Invalid cases isolate traversal, palette, namespace, geometry, executable-field rejection and header pixel limits. The pixel-bomb PNG is only a 45-byte synthetic IHDR/IEND file, with no large payload: reject its dimensions before decoding. Objects owns these files and enables related skeletons.

The valid explicit-empty layout contains a linked chair but **zero enabled seats**. The legacy file omits both editor fields and isoEditorV1 and infers desk-a without a source write. The linked-computer file requires the new adapter; the two-edge-decor file tests a complete logical window assembly. The occupied-seat-corridor fixture has ordinary door paths, but reserving the first approach prevents the second seat's aisle access. Count/bounds failures may also report missing or unreachable references.

Use repository-relative fixture discovery as existing IsoPack tests do. Do not edit Tests.csproj independently in a lane. No source fixture requires a user profile, network fetch or installed art tool. PNGs here are intentional tiny fixture source assets, not compiled binaries or captured test results. Put renders/test results/temp homes in the owning worktree's ignored artifacts folder. UI may add reviewed deterministic goldens under `render/`; the supervisor owns updates to this root README and index.
